run_convert_prior: run the script to convert a Shap-E prior checkpoint to diffusers format using --debug prior
run_convert_prior_image: run the script to convert a Shap-E prior image checkpoint to diffusers format using --debug prior_image
run_convert_renderer: run the script to convert a Shap-E transmitter checkpoint to diffusers renderer format using --debug renderer
review_prior_checkpoint_conversion: review the prior_original_checkpoint_to_diffusers_checkpoint function that maps original Shap-E prior weights to diffusers naming
review_renderer_checkpoint_conversion: review the renderer_model_original_checkpoint_to_diffusers_checkpoint function that maps Shap-E renderer weights to diffusers naming
